posts.title: Neocities Extension
posts.description: Before I started this blog I was getting interested in simple static website hosting and what I would come to learn is what people call the small (smol) web. It’s an unpolished, artsy, creative space. I found neocities which is in essence a static site host, but in spirit a community of creators living inside of this ephemeral world. posts.title: Weeding for Free
posts.description: I have been spending a fair bit of time over the last few weeks pulling Oxalis pre-caprae or "Bermuda Buttercup" from the Oak Woodlands in Golden Gate Park. Pre-caprae is an invasive in much of the world outside of its native South Africa.
